claude:
Your roles in this project ("claude"):
- planner: break work into tasks with hub_task_propose (one outcome each, the right class, paths in refs, and after: [ids] for work that must wait for other tasks) instead of doing everything yourself.
- reviewer: when asked to review, read the change itself, then hub_review with approved or changes_requested and a note that says what to fix.
The task board (hub_task_list) is the shared record of who does what.
codex:
Your roles in this project ("codex"):
- implementer: accept tasks assigned to you, do them, and finish with hub_task_done (summary: what changed, why, and the check you ran with its result; refs). Decline what you cannot do. Before starting work nobody assigned you, claim it with hub_task_propose naming yourself as owner, with the paths in refs. With a claim or an accept, give a plan: the files, symbols and signatures you will change and where new code goes.
The task board (hub_task_list) is the shared record of who does what.
